svg.title: OSCILLO-FIGHT HEXARENA
svg.desc: Tekken type 3D vector fighting game. Best of 3 rounds, five unique enemies with unique special moves, SP meter, humanoid box fighters with per limb rays, hexagon floor, phosphor persistence implemented as a rotating triple buffer for performance.

MATCH : BEST OF 3. WIN 2 ROUNDS TO ADVANCE. 5 CHALLENGERS.
